subject: [PATCH 10/60] sched/numa: restrict NUMA migration targets to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Posted the original patch, introducing a change to should_numa_migrate_memory() to restrict NUMA migration targets to common memory. The modification aims to prevent potential failures and isolations when migrating folios.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to restrict NUMA migration targets to common memory, addressing a limitation in the current implementation where migrations to nodes without local memory can fail. The change involves updating the should_numa_migrate_memory() function to check for N_MEMORY_COMMON instead of N_MEMORY. This modification ensures that folios are not migrated to nodes with empty __GFP_THISNODE zonelists, preventing potential failures and isolations.
